words.definition: To allot something means to give it to someone as their share or task.
words.uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani (vaqt, resurs yoki vazifani) kimdir uchun ajratmoq yoki ulush sifatida bermoq.
words.example: The coach allotted each team five minutes to prepare a strategy.
words.uzbekExample: Murabbiy har bir jamoaga strategiya tayyorlash uchun besh daqiqa ajratdi.
words.audioText: Allot. To allot something means to give it to someone as their share or task.
words.clozeSentence: The coach ______ted each team five minutes to prepare a strategy.

words.definition: To appall someone means to horrify, shock, or deeply disgust them.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qattiq dahshatga solmoq, lol qoldirmoq yoki larzaga keltirmoq.
words.example: The boy was appalled when he saw the tragic consequences of the car accident.
words.uzbekExample: Avtomobil halokatining fojiali oqibatlarini ko'rgan bola qattiq dahshatga tushdi.
words.audioText: Appall. To appall someone means to horrify, shock, or deeply disgust them.
words.clozeSentence: The boy was ______ed when he saw the tragic consequences of the accident.

words.definition: A cache is a hiding place, or a hidden collection of valuables, food, or weapons.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qimmatbaho narsalar, oziq-ovqat yoki qurollar yashirilgan maxfiy joy yoki omborxona.
words.example: The explorers discovered a secret cache of food left by the previous expedition.
words.uzbekExample: Tadqiqotchilar oldingi ekspeditsiya qoldirgan maxfiy oziq-ovqat omborini topdilar.
words.audioText: Cache. A cache is a hiding place, or a hidden collection of valuables.
words.clozeSentence: The explorers discovered a secret ______ of food left by the previous team.

words.definition: Convenience is the state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qulaylik, osonlik, qulay shart-sharoit.
words.example: Online shopping provides the ultimate convenience for busy working professionals.
words.uzbekExample: Onlayn xaridlar band mutaxassislar uchun mislsiz qulaylik yaratadi.
words.audioText: Convenience. Convenience is the state of being able to do something easily.
words.clozeSentence: Online shopping provides the ultimate ______ for busy working professionals.

words.definition: A dearth is a scarcity or lack of something that is needed.
words.uzbekDefinition: Yetishmovchilik, taqchillik, tanqislik.
words.example: There is an alarming dearth of qualified English teachers in remote rural schools.
words.uzbekExample: Uzoq qishloq maktablarida malakali ingliz tili o'qituvchilarining xavotirli tanqisligi mavjud.
words.audioText: Dearth. A dearth is a scarcity or lack of something.
words.clozeSentence: There is an alarming ______ of qualified teachers in remote rural schools.

words.definition: Done intentionally, consciously, and on purpose rather than by accident.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qasddan qilingan, ataylab, o'ylab qilingan.
words.example: His deliberate actions were aimed at undermining the authority of the manager.
words.uzbekExample: Uning ataylab qilgan harakatlari menejerning obro'siga putur yetkazishga qaratilgan edi.
words.audioText: Deliberate. Done intentionally, consciously, and on purpose.
words.clozeSentence: His ______ actions were aimed at undermining the authority of the manager.

words.definition: Extremely serious, urgent, or terrible in nature.
words.uzbekDefinition: Dahshatli, o'ta jiddiy, o'ta xatarli yoki ayanchli.
words.example: The economic crisis has plunged millions of families into dire poverty.
words.uzbekExample: Iqtisodiy inqiroz millionlab oilalarni o'ta ayanchli qashshoqlikka duchor qildi.
words.audioText: Dire. Extremely serious, urgent, or terrible in nature.
words.clozeSentence: The economic crisis has plunged millions of families into ______ poverty.

words.definition: When time elapses, it passes by smoothly or unnoticed.
words.uzbekDefinition: Vaqtning o'tishi, vaqt o'tmoq.
words.example: Several grueling months elapsed before the research findings were finally published.
words.uzbekExample: Tadqiqot natijalari nihoyat e'lon qilinishidan oldin bir necha og'ir oylar o'tib ketdi.
words.audioText: Elapse. When time elapses, it passes by.
words.clozeSentence: Several grueling months ______d before the research findings were published.

words.definition: The ability to understand and share the feelings, emotions, and experiences of another.
words.uzbekDefinition: Empatiya, boshqalar his-tuyg'ularini tushunish va his qila olish qobiliyati.
words.example: A great leader must possess genuine empathy for the everyday struggles of their employees.
words.uzbekExample: Buyuk yetakchi o'z xodimlarining kundalik qiyinchiliklariga nisbatan samimiy hamdardlikka ega bo'lishi kerak.
words.audioText: Empathy. The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.
words.clozeSentence: A great leader must possess genuine ______ for the struggles of employees.

words.definition: Unrealistic or coming from excessive imagination rather than reality.
words.uzbekDefinition: Xayoliy, o'ylab topilgan, g'alati yoki asossiz.
words.example: His fanciful theories about time travel were quickly dismissed by serious scientists.
words.uzbekExample: Uning vaqt sayohati haqidagi xayoliy nazariyalari jiddiy olimlar tomonidan darhol rad etildi.
words.audioText: Fanciful. Unrealistic or coming from excessive imagination.
words.clozeSentence: His ______ theories about time travel were dismissed by serious scientists.

words.definition: To complain persistently or continuously about something trivial.
words.uzbekDefinition: Nolimoq, tinimsiz arz qilmoq, norozilik bildirmoq.
words.example: The disgruntled workers began to gripe about the long working hours and low wages.
words.uzbekExample: Norozi ishchilar uzoq ish soatlari va kam maoshdan tinimsiz noli boshladilar.
words.audioText: Gripe. To complain persistently about something.
words.clozeSentence: The workers began to ______ about the long working hours and low wages.

words.definition: Extremely tiring, exhausting, and demanding great effort and endurance.
words.uzbekDefinition: O'ta mashaqqatli, toliqtiradigan, holdan toydiradigan.
words.example: The athletes completed a grueling 42-kilometer marathon in the desert heat.
words.uzbekExample: Sportchilar sahro jaziramasida mashaqqatli 42 kilometrlik marafonni yakunladilar.
words.audioText: Grueling. Extremely tiring, exhausting, and demanding.
words.clozeSentence: The athletes completed a ______ 42-kilometer marathon in the desert heat.

words.definition: Lacking interest or excitement; dull, ordinary, and routine.
words.uzbekDefinition: Oddiy, jo'n, zerikarli, kundalik odatiy.
words.example: She found cleaning the house to be a completely mundane and uninspiring chore.
words.uzbekExample: U uyni tozalashni mutlaqo oddiy va zerikarli kundalik yumush deb bildi.
words.audioText: Mundane. Lacking interest or excitement; dull and ordinary.
words.clozeSentence: She found cleaning the house to be a completely ______ and uninspiring chore.

words.definition: To make a choice or decision from a range of available possibilities.
words.uzbekDefinition: Tanlamoq, ma'qul ko'rmoq, qaror qilmoq.
words.example: Many high-achieving students opt to study abroad for better research opportunities.
words.uzbekExample: Ko'plab a'lochi talabalar yaxshiroq ilmiy imkoniyatlar uchun chet elda o'qishni tanlaydilar.
words.audioText: Opt. To make a choice or decision from possibilities.
words.clozeSentence: Many high-achieving students ______ to study abroad for research opportunities.

words.definition: An extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.
words.uzbekDefinition: G'azab, kuchli nafrat, g'azablanish yoki haqoratli holat.
words.example: The corrupt politician's light sentence caused widespread public outrage across the country.
words.uzbekExample: Korrupsioner siyosatchiga yengil jazo berilishi butun mamlakat bo'ylab kuchli xalq g'azabiga sabab bo'ldi.
words.audioText: Outrage. An extremely strong reaction of anger or shock.
words.clozeSentence: The corrupt politician's light sentence caused widespread public ______.

words.definition: Very small, meager, or worthless in amount or importance.
words.uzbekDefinition: Arzimagan, juda oz, arzimas miqdordagi.
words.example: The intern was paid a paltry salary that could barely cover the cost of daily bus tickets.
words.uzbekExample: Amaliyotchiga hatto kunlik avtobus chiptasini zo'rg'a qoplaydigan arzimagan maosh to'landi.
words.audioText: Paltry. Very small, meager, or worthless in amount.
words.clozeSentence: The intern was paid a ______ salary that barely covered bus tickets.

words.definition: To put right, correct, or remedy an error, problem, or mistake.
words.uzbekDefinition: Tuzatmoq, to'g'rilamoq, xatolikni bartaraf etmoq.
words.example: The software engineering team worked tirelessly overnight to rectify the critical database bug.
words.uzbekExample: Dasturchilar jamoasi ma'lumotlar bazasidagi jiddiy xatoni tuzatish uchun tun bo'yi tinimsiz ishladilar.
words.audioText: Rectify. To put right, correct, or remedy an error.
words.clozeSentence: The software engineering team worked overnight to ______ the critical bug.

words.definition: Having the practical ability to find quick, clever ways to overcome difficulties.
words.uzbekDefinition: Topqir, uddaburon, qiyin vaziyatdan yo'l topa oladigan.
words.example: A resourceful detective can solve the most intricate mystery with minimal clues.
words.uzbekExample: Topqir tergovchi eng murakkab jumboqni ham ozgina dalillar bilan yecha oladi.
words.audioText: Resourceful. Having the ability to find clever ways to overcome difficulties.
words.clozeSentence: A ______ detective can solve the most intricate mystery with minimal clues.

words.definition: Food and drink regarded as a source of strength, nutrition, and nourishment.
words.uzbekDefinition: Oziq-ovqat, tiriklik manbai, hayotiy quvvat beruvchi ozuqa.
words.example: Without proper sustenance and clean water, human beings cannot survive more than a few days.
words.uzbekExample: To'g'ri ozuqa va toza suvsiz inson bir necha kundan ortiq yashay olmaydi.
words.audioText: Sustenance. Food and drink regarded as a source of strength.
words.clozeSentence: Without proper ______ and clean water, humans cannot survive more than a few days.

words.definition: Too long, slow, or dull; tiresome and monotonous.
words.uzbekDefinition: Zerikarli, cho'ziq, bir xil va toliqtiradigan.
words.example: Manually entering thousands of rows of financial data into a spreadsheet is a tedious job.
words.uzbekExample: Minglab moliyaviy ma'lumotlar qatorlarini jadvalga qo'lda kiritish juda zerikarli ishdir.
words.audioText: Tedious. Too long, slow, or dull; tiresome and monotonous.
words.clozeSentence: Manually entering thousands of rows into a spreadsheet is a ______ job.

words.definition: A building or complex where monks or nuns live, work, and pray.
words.uzbekDefinition: Abbatlik, monaxlar yashaydigan va ibodat qiladigan qadimiy monastir.
words.example: Westminster Abbey in London is renowned for royal weddings and historic coronations.
words.uzbekExample: Londondagi Vestminster abbatligi qirollik to'ylari va tarixiy tojbosh kiyish marosimlari bilan mashhur.
words.audioText: Abbey. A building where monks or nuns live and worship.
words.clozeSentence: Westminster ______ in London is renowned for historic royal coronations.

words.definition: Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful and rich.
words.uzbekDefinition: Mo'l-ko'l, bisyor, serob va ko'p miqdorda mavjud.
words.example: The valley is famous for its fertile soil and abundant fresh fruit harvests.
words.uzbekExample: Vodiy o'zining unumdor tuprog'i va mo'l-ko'l yangi meva hosillari bilan mashhur.
words.audioText: Abundant. Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.
words.clozeSentence: The valley is famous for its fertile soil and ______ fruit harvests.

words.definition: To be next to and joined with a building, room, or piece of land.
words.uzbekDefinition: Yondosh bo'lmoq, tutashmoq, chegaradosh bo'lmoq.
words.example: The luxurious master bedroom adjoins a spacious private marble bathroom.
words.uzbekExample: Hashamatli asosiy yotoqxona keng xususiy marmar hammomga tutashgan.
words.audioText: Adjoin. To be next to and joined with a building or land.
words.clozeSentence: The luxurious master bedroom ______s a spacious private marble bathroom.

words.definition: Enough or more than enough; plentiful and generous in size or amount.
words.uzbekDefinition: Yetarli, yetarlicha ko'p, keng va mo'l.
words.example: The students were given ample time to double-check their exam answers before submitting.
words.uzbekExample: Talabalarga imtihon javoblarini topshirishdan oldin qayta tekshirib olish uchun yetarlicha vaqt berildi.
words.audioText: Ample. Enough or more than enough; plentiful.
words.clozeSentence: The students were given ______ time to double-check their exam answers.

words.definition: Having little or no rain; too dry or barren to support plentiful vegetation.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qurg'oqchil, juda quruq, qaqragan iqlim yoki yer.
words.example: Cactus plants have evolved unique biological structures to survive in extremely arid deserts.
words.uzbekExample: Kaktuslar o'ta qurg'oqchil sahrolarda yashab qolish uchun noyob biologik tuzilishga ega bo'lgan.
words.audioText: Arid. Having little or no rain; too dry to support vegetation.
words.clozeSentence: Cactus plants have evolved unique structures to survive in extremely ______ deserts.

words.definition: A very large, important church that is the headquarters of a bishop.
words.uzbekDefinition: Bosh cherkov, kafedral sobor, mahobatli diniy bino.
words.example: Tourists were mesmerized by the stained-glass windows of the Gothic cathedral.
words.uzbekExample: Sayyohlar Gotika uslubidagi bosh soborning vitraj oynalaridan lol qoldilar.
words.audioText: Cathedral. A very large, important church that is the principal church of a diocese.
words.clozeSentence: Tourists were mesmerized by the stained-glass windows of the Gothic ______.

words.definition: To prevent someone from having or enjoying something essential.
words.uzbekDefinition: Mahrum qilmoq, biror muhim narsadan bebahra qoldirmoq.
words.example: Prolonged insomnia can deprive the human brain of crucial restorative sleep.
words.uzbekExample: Uzoq muddatli uyqusizlik inson miyasini hayotiy muhim oromdan mahrum qilishi mumkin.
words.audioText: Deprive. To prevent someone from having or enjoying something.
words.clozeSentence: Prolonged insomnia can ______ the human brain of crucial restorative sleep.

words.definition: A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall, leading to a shortage of water.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qurg'oqchilik, uzoq vaqt yog'ingarchilik bo'lmasligi oqibatidagi suv tanqisligi.
words.example: The severe drought destroyed thousands of hectares of crops and caused famine.
words.uzbekExample: Qattiq qurg'oqchilik minglab gektar ekinlarni nobud qildi va ocharchilikka olib keldi.
words.audioText: Drought. A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall.

words.definition: Having the right qualifications or meeting the necessary conditions to participate.
words.uzbekDefinition: Munosib, shartlarga to'g'ri keladigan, huquqi bor.
words.example: Only university graduates with an IELTS band of 7.0 or higher are eligible for the scholarship.
words.uzbekExample: Faqat IELTS bali 7.0 yoki undan yuqori bo'lgan oliygoh bitiruvchilari stipendiyaga munosib hisoblanadi.
words.audioText: Eligible. Having the right qualifications or meeting conditions.
words.clozeSentence: Only graduates with high scores are ______ for this prestigious international scholarship.

words.definition: To abstain from all or certain kinds of food or drink, especially for religious or health reasons.
words.uzbekDefinition: Ro'za tutmoq, ovqatlanishdan ma'lum vaqt tiyilmoq.
words.example: Millions of Muslims around the world fast from dawn to sunset during Ramadan.
words.uzbekExample: Ramazon oyida dunyo bo'ylab millionlab musulmonlar tongdan quyosh botguncha ro'za tutadilar.
words.audioText: Fast. To abstain from food or drink, especially for health or religion.
words.clozeSentence: Millions of Muslims around the globe ______ from dawn to sunset during Ramadan.

words.definition: To complain in a bad-tempered, quiet way; to murmur discontentedly.
words.uzbekDefinition: To'ng'illamoq, norozi bo'lib g'o'ng'irlamoq, pichirlab nolimoq.
words.example: Commuters began to grumble when the morning commuter train was delayed by forty minutes.
words.uzbekExample: Tonggi poyezd qirq daqiqaga kechikkanida yo'lovchilar to'ng'illab norozilik bildira boshladilar.
words.audioText: Grumble. To complain in a bad-tempered, quiet way.
words.clozeSentence: Commuters began to ______ when the morning train was delayed by forty minutes.

words.definition: Situated in or moving toward the interior of a country away from the sea.
words.uzbekDefinition: Mamlakat ichkarisiga, dengizdan uzoq ichki hududda.
words.example: The coastal residents moved inland to find safety before the devastating hurricane arrived.
words.uzbekExample: Qirg'oqbo'yi aholisi dahshatli to'fon kelishidan oldin xavfsizlik topish maqsadida ichkari hududga ko'chib o'tdi.
words.audioText: Inland. Situated in or moving toward the interior of a country away from the coast.
words.clozeSentence: The residents moved ______ to find safety before the hurricane struck the coast.

words.definition: Water or other liquid diffused in a small quantity as vapor, within a solid, or condensed on a surface.
words.uzbekDefinition: Namlik, rutubat, suv tomchilari.
words.example: Desert plants possess a thick waxy outer layer to prevent loss of vital moisture.
words.uzbekExample: Sahro o'simliklari hayotiy namlikni yo'qotmaslik uchun qalin mumsimon qatlamga ega bo'ladi.
words.audioText: Moisture. Water or other liquid diffused in small quantity.
words.clozeSentence: Desert plants possess a waxy outer layer to prevent loss of vital ______.

words.definition: In spite of that; nevertheless.
words.uzbekDefinition: Shunga qaramay, baribir, shunday bo'lsa ham.
words.example: The math exam was exceptionally challenging; nonetheless, Maria scored a perfect mark.
words.uzbekExample: Matematika imtihoni nihoyatda qiyin edi; shunga qaramasdan, Mariya eng yuqori ballni oldi.

translations.russian: Тем не менее, все же, несмотря на это

words.audioText: Nonetheless. In spite of that; nevertheless.

words.definition: A solemn or formal promise, often calling upon God or a sacred object as a witness.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qasamyod, tantanali va'da, ont.
words.example: The president placed his hand on the constitution and solemnly took the oath of office.
words.uzbekExample: Prezident qo'lini konstitutsiyaga qo'yib, tantanali ravishda lavozim qasamyodini qabul qildi.
words.audioText: Oath. A solemn or formal promise.
words.clozeSentence: The president placed his hand on the constitution and solemnly took the ______.

words.definition: A large, open area of grassland, especially in North America.
words.uzbekDefinition: Preriya, keng va bepoyon o'tloq dasht.
words.example: Vast herds of wild bison once roamed freely across the North American prairie.
words.uzbekExample: Bir paytlar yovvoyi bizonlarning ulkan podalari Shimoliy Amerika dashtlarida erkin kezib yurgan.
words.audioText: Prairie. A large, open area of grassland.
words.clozeSentence: Vast herds of bison once roamed freely across the North American ______.

words.definition: Old, torn, and in bad condition; wearing worn-out clothes.
words.uzbekDefinition: Yirtiq, titilgan, eskirgan, juldur.
words.example: The poor orphan was shivering in the freezing winter wind in his ragged coat.
words.uzbekExample: Kambag'al yetim bola o'zining juldur paltosida qahraton qish shamolida qaltirab turardi.
words.audioText: Ragged. Old, torn, and in bad condition.
words.clozeSentence: The poor orphan was shivering in the freezing wind in his ______ coat.

words.definition: Having a broken, rocky, and uneven surface; strong and tough.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qoyali, g'adir-budur, qattiq va toshloq; chidamli.
words.example: The hikers struggled to navigate through the rugged mountainous terrain.
words.uzbekExample: Sayyohlar qoyali va g'adir-budur tog'li hududdan o'tishda qiynaldilar.
words.audioText: Rugged. Having a broken, rocky, and uneven surface.
words.clozeSentence: The hikers struggled to navigate through the ______ mountainous terrain.

words.definition: Insufficient for the demand; hard to find or rare.
words.uzbekDefinition: Taqchil, kamyob, yetishmaydigan, kam uchraydigan.
words.example: Clean drinking water became increasingly scarce as the severe summer drought persisted.
words.uzbekExample: Yozgi qattiq qurg'oqchilik davom etgani sari toza ichimlik suvi tobora taqchil bo'lib bordi.
words.audioText: Scarce. Insufficient for the demand; hard to find.
words.clozeSentence: Clean drinking water became increasingly ______ as the summer drought continued.

words.definition: To form a theory or conjecture about a subject without firm evidence.
words.uzbekDefinition: Faraz qilmoq, taxmin qilmoq, o'ylab mulohaza yuritmoq.
words.example: Journalists began to speculate on who would be appointed as the next prime minister.
words.uzbekExample: Jurnalistlar kim yangi bosh vazir etib tayinlanishi haqida turli taxminlar qila boshladilar.
words.audioText: Speculate. To form a theory about a subject without firm evidence.
words.clozeSentence: Journalists began to ______ on who would be appointed as the next prime minister.

words.definition: Using or involving careful analysis and logical examination of complex parts.
words.uzbekDefinition: Tahliliy, mantiqiy tahlilga asoslangan, mayda qismlargacha sinchiklab o'rganadigan.
words.example: The IELTS Academic test requires strong analytic thinking skills to interpret visual charts.
words.uzbekExample: IELTS Academic imtihoni vizual diagrammalarni tushunish uchun kuchli tahliliy fikrlashni talab qiladi.
words.audioText: Analytic. Using or involving careful analysis and logical examination.
words.clozeSentence: The test requires strong ______ thinking skills to interpret visual charts.

words.definition: To state a fact or belief confidently, firmly, and forcefully.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qat'iy ta'kidlamoq, dadil va ishonch bilan aytmoq.
words.example: The scientist asserted that renewable green energy could power entire modern cities.
words.uzbekExample: Olim qayta tiklanuvchi yashil energiya butun zamonaviy shaharlarni ta'minlay olishini qat'iy ta'kidladi.
words.audioText: Assert. To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.
words.clozeSentence: The scientist ______ed that renewable energy could power entire cities.

words.definition: An unmarried man; also a degree awarded by a university to an undergraduate student.
words.uzbekDefinition: Bakalavr darajasi; shuningdek, uylanmagan bo'ydoq erkak.
words.example: After graduating with a Bachelor of Science, Farhod applied for an international master's program.
words.uzbekExample: Fanlar bo'yicha bakalavr darajasini tugatgach, Farhod xalqaro magistratura dasturiga hujjat topshirdi.
words.audioText: Bachelor. An unmarried man or a university first degree.
words.clozeSentence: After completing his ______ degree, he applied for an international scholarship.

words.definition: A branch of advanced mathematics that deals with rates of change and accumulation.
words.uzbekDefinition: Matematik tahlil, oliy matematika hisob-kitob bo'limi (differensial va integral).
words.example: Engineering students must master differential calculus to solve aerodynamics problems.
words.uzbekExample: Muhandislik talabalari aerodinamika masalalarini yechish uchun differensial hisobni o'zlashtirishlari shart.
words.audioText: Calculus. A branch of mathematics dealing with rates of change.
words.clozeSentence: Engineering students must master differential ______ to solve complex problems.

words.definition: Relating to the sky or outer space as observed in astronomy; heavenly.
words.uzbekDefinition: Samoviy, osmonga oid, fazoga yoki jannatga daxldor.
words.example: Comets, stars, and distant planets are all fascinating celestial bodies.
words.uzbekExample: Kometalar, yulduzlar va uzoq sayyoralarning barchasi maftunkor samoviy jismlardir.

words.definition: Concerned with or involving the theory of a subject or area of study rather than its practical application.

words.definition: Very skilled or proficient at something.
words.uzbekDefinition: Usta, epchil, biror ishni g'oyat mohirlik bilan bajaradigan.
words.example: She became adept at resolving complex customer disputes calmly and diplomatically.
words.uzbekExample: U mijozlar o'rtasidagi murakkab nizolarni bosiqlik va diplomatiya bilan hal qilishda mohir bo'lib yetishdi.
words.audioText: Adept. Very skilled or proficient at something.
words.clozeSentence: She became remarkably ______ at mediating tense diplomatic conflicts.

words.definition: Land too poor to produce much or any vegetation; bleak and lifeless.
words.uzbekDefinition: Unumsiz, qaqragan, ekin o'smaydigan quruq yer.
words.example: The volcanic eruption turned the lush green farmland into a desolate, barren wasteland.
words.uzbekExample: Vulqon otilishi yam-yashil unumdor dehqonchilik yerlarini kimsasiz, unumsiz biyobonga aylantirdi.
words.audioText: Barren. Land too poor to produce vegetation; bleak.
words.clozeSentence: Excessive chemical salinization turned the farm into ______ wasteland.

words.definition: Made of clay and hardened by heat, or relating to pottery.
words.uzbekDefinition: Keramik, sopol, loydan yasalib olovda pishirilgan.
words.example: Samarkand is globally famed for its majestic mosques adorned with turquoise ceramic tiles.
words.uzbekExample: Samarqand feruza rangli sopol koshinlar bilan bezatilgan muhtasham masjidlari bilan dunyoga mashhur.
words.audioText: Ceramic. Made of clay and permanently hardened by intense heat.
words.clozeSentence: Ancient craftsmen in Rishtan decorated exquisite ______ plates with floral patterns.

words.definition: Of or for cooking; relating to kitchens and gastronomy.
words.uzbekDefinition: Pazandalik, oshxona va ovqat pishirish san'atiga oid.
words.example: Tashkent offers an extraordinary culinary experience renowned for flavorful plov and samsa.
words.uzbekExample: Toshkent mazali osh va somsasi bilan tanilgan ajoyib pazandalik tajribasini taqdim etadi.
words.audioText: Culinary. Of or for cooking; relating to the kitchen.
words.clozeSentence: The master chef displayed his magnificent ______ skills at the banquet.

words.definition: Closely compacted in substance; having parts crowded closely together.
words.uzbekDefinition: Zich, qalin, quyuq, bir-biriga juda yaqin joylashgan.
words.example: The mountain hikers got lost in the dense, impenetrable fog that rolled in at dusk.
words.uzbekExample: Tog' sayyohlari shom paytida tushgan quyuq va qalin tumanda adashib qoldilar.
words.audioText: Dense. Closely compacted in substance; crowded.
words.clozeSentence: It was nearly impossible to see through the extraordinarily ______ morning fog.

words.definition: The state or quality of being worthy of honor or respect; self-respect.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qadr-qimmat, sha'n, o'zini hurmat qilish tuyg'usi.
words.example: Even in the face of bitter defeat, the champion maintained his poise, grace, and dignity.
words.uzbekExample: Hatto achchiq mag'lubiyat oldida ham chempion o'zining viqori, bosiqligi va qadr-qimmatini saqlab qoldi.
words.audioText: Dignity. The state of being worthy of honor or respect.
words.clozeSentence: Every human being possesses an inalienable right to be treated with ______.

words.definition: To have a commanding influence on; exercise control over.
words.uzbekDefinition: Hukmronlik qilmoq, ustunlik qilmoq, nazorat ostida ushlab turmoq.
words.example: A few massive multinational corporations currently dominate the global smartphone market.
words.uzbekExample: Hozirda bir nechta yirik transmilliy korporatsiyalar jahon smartfon bozorida hukmronlik qilmoqda.
words.audioText: Dominate. To have a commanding influence on; control.
words.clozeSentence: Tech giants now ______ international digital advertising platforms.

words.definition: Fit to be safely eaten; not poisonous.
words.uzbekDefinition: Yeyishga yaroqli, iste'mol qilsa bo'ladigan, zaharsiz.
words.example: Never pick wild mushrooms in the forest unless you are completely certain they are edible.
words.uzbekExample: O'rmonda yovvoyi qo'ziqorinlarni yeyishga yaroqli ekaniga to'liq ishonchingiz komil bo'lmaguncha aslo termang.
words.audioText: Edible. Fit to be safely eaten; not poisonous.
words.clozeSentence: Always verify that wild forest berries are entirely ______ before consuming them.

words.definition: Unfriendly; antagonistic; opposed to someone or something.
words.uzbekDefinition: Dushmanona, tajovuzkor, qarshi va noxush munosabatda bo'lgan.
words.example: Explorers faced extreme dangers while trekking across the bitterly cold, hostile Arctic wilderness.
words.uzbekExample: Sayyohlar qahraton sovuq, dushmanona Arktika dashtlaridan o'tishda o'ta xavfli vaziyatlarga duch keldilar.
words.audioText: Hostile. Unfriendly; antagonistic; opposed to someone.
words.clozeSentence: The harsh desert is a deeply ______ environment for unprepared explorers.

words.definition: An amount of food, air, or another substance taken into the body.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qabul qilingan miqdor, iste'mol qilish (ovqat, suv, kaloriya haqida).
words.example: Nutritionists strongly recommend reducing your daily intake of refined sugars and sodium.
words.uzbekExample: Parhezshunoslar tozalangan shakar va natriyning kunlik iste'mol miqdorini kamaytirishni qat'iy tavsiya qiladilar.
words.audioText: Intake. An amount of food, air, or substance taken into the body.
words.clozeSentence: Doctors recommend reducing your daily ______ of processed salt and sugars.

words.definition: In the same way; similarly; also.
words.uzbekDefinition: Shuningdek, xuddi shunday, o'xshash tarzda.
words.example: The math teacher was impressed by Sardor's analytical essay, and his classmates felt likewise.
words.uzbekExample: Matematika o'qituvchisi Sardorning tahliliy inshosidan hayratda qoldi va sinfdoshlari ham xuddi shunday his qildilar.
words.audioText: Likewise. In the same way; similarly.
words.clozeSentence: The coach praised her tenacity, and the team members felt ______.

words.definition: Lack of proper nutrition, caused by not having enough to eat or not eating the right foods.
words.uzbekDefinition: To'yib ovqatlanmaslik, yetarli vitamin va ozuqa olmaslik natijasidagi holsizlik.
words.example: Severe childhood malnutrition stunts physical growth and hinders normal cognitive development.
words.uzbekExample: Bolalikdagi og'ir to'yib ovqatlanmaslik jismoniy o'sishni to'xtatadi va normal aqliy rivojlanishga to'sqinlik qiladi.
words.audioText: Malnutrition. Lack of proper nutrition caused by inadequate diet.
words.clozeSentence: The aid organization launched relief missions to combat child ______ in the famine zone.

words.definition: A substance used for medical treatment, especially a drug or group of drugs.
words.uzbekDefinition: Dori-darmon, davolanish uchun qabul qilinadigan dori vositasi.
words.example: The doctor emphasized that the patient must take the prescribed blood pressure medication on time.
words.uzbekExample: Shifokor bemor qon bosimiga qarshi yozilgan dori-darmonni o'z vaqtida qabul qilishi shartligini ta'kidladi.
words.audioText: Medication. A substance used for medical treatment.
words.clozeSentence: You must complete the full cycle of antibiotic ______ as directed by your physician.

words.definition: A view or opinion that is incorrect because based on faulty thinking or understanding.
words.uzbekDefinition: Noto'g'ri tushuncha, yanglish tasavvur, xato fikr.
words.example: It is a common misconception that reading faster automatically decreases comprehension.
words.uzbekExample: Tezroq o'qish avtomatik ravishda matnni tushunishni pasaytiradi degan fikr keng tarqalgan noto'g'ri tushunchadir.
words.audioText: Misconception. A view or opinion that is incorrect based on faulty understanding.
words.clozeSentence: The scientific documentary dispelled the popular ______ about bat blindness.

words.definition: Not discovered or known about; uncertain; difficult to understand.
words.uzbekDefinition: Noma'lum, tushunarsiz, kamdan-kam odam biladigan yoki xira.
words.example: The historian discovered an obscure 15th-century manuscript tucked away in the archives.
words.uzbekExample: Tarixchi arxivlar tubida yashiringan 15-asrga oid kam ma'lum bo'lgan qadimiy qo'lyozmani topdi.
words.audioText: Obscure. Not discovered or known about; uncertain.
words.clozeSentence: The researcher uncovered an ______ historical document preserved in dusty archives.

words.definition: To keep someone in subservience and hardship, especially by the unjust exercise of authority.
words.uzbekDefinition: Zulm qilmoq, ezmoq, nohaq kuch va jabr bilan ezib turmoq.
words.example: The authoritarian dictator used brutal police force to oppress the innocent population.
words.uzbekExample: Avtoritar diktator begunoh aholiga zulm qilish uchun shafqatsiz politsiya kuchidan foydalandi.
words.audioText: Oppress. To keep someone in hardship by the unjust exercise of power.
words.clozeSentence: The ruthless regime attempted to ______ all public dissent and free press.

words.definition: To remove the outer covering or skin from a fruit, vegetable, or other item.
words.uzbekDefinition: Po'stini archmoq, ustki qavatini tozalab olib tashlamoq.
words.example: Please carefully peel the oranges and slice them neatly for the fruit salad.
words.uzbekExample: Iltimos, apelsinlarning po'stini ehtiyotkorlik bilan arching va mevali salat uchun chiroyli qilib to'g'rang.
words.audioText: Peel. To remove the outer covering or skin from fruit.
words.clozeSentence: Please carefully ______ the crisp apples before blending them into puree.

words.definition: An instruction written by a medical practitioner that authorizes a patient to be provided with a medicine.
words.uzbekDefinition: Retsept, shifokor tomonidan bemorga dori berish uchun yozilgan rasmiy ko'rsatma.
words.example: You cannot purchase strong antibiotics at the local pharmacy without a valid doctor's prescription.
words.uzbekExample: Mahalliy dorixonada shifokorning amaldagi retseptisiz kuchli antibiotiklarni sotib ololmaysiz.
words.audioText: Prescription. An instruction written by a doctor for medicine.
words.clozeSentence: You cannot purchase specialized pharmaceuticals without a doctor's signed ______.

words.definition: An apparatus worn over the mouth and nose or that helps someone breathe.
words.uzbekDefinition: Respirator, havoni tozalovchi niqob yoki sun'iy nafas berish apparati.
words.example: Miners wear a protective respirator to avoid inhaling toxic mineral dust underground.
words.uzbekExample: Konchilar yer ostida zaharli mineral changini yutmaslik uchun himoya respiratorini taqadilar.
words.audioText: Respirator. An apparatus worn over the mouth and nose to protect breathing.
words.clozeSentence: Chemical workers must wear a certified ______ when handling volatile solvents.

words.definition: To make great efforts to achieve or obtain something; struggle.
words.uzbekDefinition: Intilmoq, astoydil harakat qilmoq, maqsad yo'lida jon-jahdi bilan kurashmoq.
words.example: Diligent IELTS students constantly strive for academic excellence and vocabulary mastery.
words.uzbekExample: Tirishqoq IELTS talabalari doimo akademik yuksaklikka va so'z boyligini puxta egallashga intiladilar.
words.audioText: Strive. To make great efforts to achieve something.
words.clozeSentence: Dedicated learners constantly ______ for excellence in their academic disciplines.

words.definition: Very old or old-fashioned; belonging to an earlier period in history.
words.uzbekDefinition: Eskirgan, qadimiy, arxaik, zamonaviy tilda deyarli ishlatilmaydigan.
words.example: The legal document contained archaic phrasing that baffled modern law students.
words.uzbekExample: Yuridik hujjatda zamonaviy huquqshunos talabalarni hayratga solgan eskirgan so'z birikmalari mavjud edi.
words.audioText: Archaic. Very old or old-fashioned.
words.clozeSentence: The medieval treaty contained ______ phrasing that puzzled modern readers.

words.definition: Well meaning and kindly; serving a charitable rather than profit-making purpose.
words.uzbekDefinition: Mehribon, saxovatli, xayr-ehson qiluvchi, ezgu niyatli.
words.example: The benevolent billionaire donated millions of dollars to build free cancer clinics.
words.uzbekExample: Saxovatli milliarder bepul saraton klinikalarini qurish uchun millionlab dollar xayriya qildi.
words.audioText: Benevolent. Well meaning and kindly; charitable.
words.clozeSentence: The ______ donor contributed generously to fund rural schools and libraries.

words.definition: A yellow alloy of copper and zinc, often used for musical instruments and decorative objects.
words.uzbekDefinition: Jez, latun, mis va rux qotishmasi; musiqiy cholg'ular yasaladigan sariq metall.
words.example: The orchestra's brass section, featuring trumpets and trombones, sounded triumphant.
words.uzbekExample: Orkestrning truba va trombonlardan iborat jez cholg'ulari bo'limi g'olibona yangradi.
words.audioText: Brass. A yellow alloy of copper and zinc.
words.clozeSentence: The front antique door was equipped with a polished ______ doorknob.

words.definition: An economic and political system in which a country's trade and industry are controlled by private owners for profit.
words.uzbekDefinition: Kapitalizm, savdo va ishlab chiqarish xususiy mulk egalari tomonidan boshqariladigan iqtisodiy tuzum.
words.example: Free-market capitalism fosters entrepreneurial innovation, competition, and economic efficiency.
words.uzbekExample: Erkin bozor kapitalizmi tadbirkorlik innovatsiyasini, raqobatni va iqtisodiy samaradorlikni rivojlantiradi.
words.audioText: Capitalism. An economic system controlled by private owners for profit.
words.clozeSentence: Free-market ______ encourages competitive innovation and commercial trade.

words.definition: A part or element of a larger whole, especially a machine or system.
words.uzbekDefinition: Tarkibiy qism, komponent, butunning ajralmas bo'lagi.
words.example: Regular active vocabulary revision is a critical component of successful IELTS preparation.
words.uzbekExample: Lug'at boyligini muntazam faol takrorlash muvaffaqiyatli IELTS tayyorgarligining muhim tarkibiy qismidir.
words.audioText: Component. A part or element of a larger whole.
words.clozeSentence: Active vocabulary practice is an essential ______ of language mastery.

words.definition: The state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else.
words.uzbekDefinition: Qaramlik, tobelik, boshqalarga suyanib qolish holati.
words.example: Many developed nations are striving to decrease their heavy dependence on imported fossil fuels.
words.uzbekExample: Ko'plab rivojlangan davlatlar import qilinadigan qazilma yoqilg'ilarga kuchli qaramlikni kamaytirishga intilmoqdalar.
words.audioText: Dependence. The state of relying on someone or something else.
words.clozeSentence: Countries strive to reduce their heavy ______ on foreign energy imports.

words.definition: To make or become less; reduce in size, extent, or importance.
words.uzbekDefinition: Kamaymoq, kamaytirmoq, qisqarmoq yoki ta'sirini susaytirmoq.
words.example: His intense enthusiasm for the project began to diminish after repeated budget cuts.
words.uzbekExample: Kompaniyadagi takroriy byudjet qisqartirishlaridan so'ng uning loyihaga bo'lgan kuchli ishtiyoqi so'na boshladi.
words.audioText: Diminish. To make or become less; reduce.
words.clozeSentence: His energy and motivation began to ______ after hours of continuous labor.

words.definition: A feature that renders something less acceptable; a disadvantage or problem.
words.uzbekDefinition: Kamchilik, salbiy jihat, noqulaylik, nuqson.
words.example: The main drawback of living in a bustling megacity is the suffocating traffic congestion.
words.uzbekExample: Katta gavjum megapolisda yashashning asosiy kamchiligi bu bo'g'uvchi tirbandliklardir.
words.audioText: Drawback. A disadvantage or problem.
words.clozeSentence: The primary ______ of this electric car is its limited battery driving range.

words.definition: An intense and widely shared enthusiasm for something, especially one that is short-lived; a craze.
words.uzbekDefinition: Vaqtinchalik moda, o'tkinchi qiziqish, tezda o'tib ketadigan urf.
words.example: Many strict internet diets turn out to be nothing more than a passing celebrity fad.
words.uzbekExample: Internetdagi ko'plab qat'iy parhezlar vaqtinchalik yulduzlar modasidan boshqa narsa emasligi ma'lum bo'ladi.
words.audioText: Fad. An intense enthusiasm for something that is short-lived.
words.clozeSentence: The fidget spinner was a worldwide teenage ______ that disappeared rapidly.

words.definition: To force an unwelcome decision, tax, or law to be accepted or put in place.
words.uzbekDefinition: Yuklamoq, joriy qilmoq, majburan qabul qildirmoq (soliq, jazo, qoida).
words.example: The United Nations voted to impose strict trade sanctions on the aggressive regime.
words.uzbekExample: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkiloti tajovuzkor tuzumga nisbatan qat'iy savdo sanksiyalarini joriy qilish uchun ovoz berdi.
words.audioText: Impose. To force an unwelcome decision or law to be accepted.
words.clozeSentence: The government decided to ______ high tariffs on imported luxury goods.

words.definition: Relating to management or managers; administrative.
words.uzbekDefinition: Boshqaruvga oid, menejerlikka xos, ma'muriy rahbarlikka daxldor.
words.example: Promoting her to a senior managerial role recognized her exceptional leadership qualities.
words.uzbekExample: Uni yuqori boshqaruv lavozimiga ko'tarish uning ajoyib yetakchilik qobiliyatlarini e'tirof etdi.
words.audioText: Managerial. Relating to management or managers.
words.clozeSentence: He was promoted to a key ______ post due to his outstanding leadership.

words.definition: Relating to the Middle Ages in European history (roughly 500–1500 AD).
words.uzbekDefinition: O'rta asrlarga oid, o'rta asr davri tarixi bilan bog'liq.
words.example: Tourists marveled at the imposing stone walls of the preserved medieval castle in Prague.
words.uzbekExample: Sayyohlar Pragadagi saqlanib qolgan o'rta asrlarga oid qasrning mahobatli tosh devorlariga qarab hayratga tushdilar.
words.audioText: Medieval. Relating to the Middle Ages.
words.clozeSentence: Tourists marveled at the stone fortresses of the preserved ______ city.

words.definition: No longer produced or used; out of date.
words.uzbekDefinition: Eskirgan, iste'moldan chiqqan, o'rniga yangisi kelgani uchun ishlatilmaydigan.
words.example: Smartphones with touchscreens made traditional keypad cellphones practically obsolete.
words.uzbekExample: Sensorli ekranli smartfonlar an'anaviy tugmachali telefonlarni amalda iste'moldan chiqardi.
words.audioText: Obsolete. No longer produced or used; out of date.
words.clozeSentence: Digital streaming platforms made plastic VHS video cassettes completely ______.

words.definition: A piece of land almost surrounded by water or projecting out into a body of water.
words.uzbekDefinition: Yarimorol, uch tomoni suv bilan o'ralgan quruqlik qismi.
words.example: Florida is a sunny American peninsula bordered by the Atlantic Ocean and the Gulf of Mexico.
words.uzbekExample: Florida – Atlantika okeani va Meksika ko'rfazi bilan o'ralgan quyoshli Amerika yarimorolidir.
words.audioText: Peninsula. A piece of land almost surrounded by water.
words.clozeSentence: Italy is a famous European boot-shaped ______ stretching into the Mediterranean.

words.definition: Widespread respect and admiration felt for someone on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.
words.uzbekDefinition: Obro'-e'tibor, nufuz, yuksak martaba.
words.example: Winning the Nobel Prize in Physics confers immense worldwide prestige and scientific recognition.
words.uzbekExample: Fizika bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini qo'lga kiritish ulkan jahon miqyosidagi nufuz va ilmiy e'tirof keltiradi.
words.audioText: Prestige. Widespread respect and admiration on the basis of achievements.
words.clozeSentence: Studying at Oxford confers enormous international academic ______ on graduates.

words.definition: A part, share, or number considered in comparative relation to a whole.
words.uzbekDefinition: Nisbat, ulush, mutanosiblik, qism.
words.example: A significant proportion of university students work part-time jobs to pay tuition fees.
words.uzbekExample: Universitet talabalarining katta bir qismi o'qish to'lovlarini qoplash uchun yarim stavkada ishlaydi.
words.audioText: Proportion. A part or share considered in relation to a whole.
words.clozeSentence: A substantial ______ of the state budget is allocated to public healthcare.

words.definition: Relating to or affecting the fundamental nature of something; far-reaching or thorough.
words.uzbekDefinition: Tub, keskin, ildiziga taalluqli, tubdan o'zgartiruvchi.
words.example: The ministry introduced radical reforms to modernize the national education curriculum.
words.uzbekExample: Vazirlik milliy ta'lim dasturini modernizatsiya qilish uchun tub islohotlarni joriy qildi.
words.audioText: Radical. Affecting the fundamental nature of something; far-reaching.
words.clozeSentence: The university decided on a ______ overhaul of its digital testing system.

words.definition: To prove a statement or theory to be wrong or false; disprove.
words.uzbekDefinition: Rad etmoq, xatoligini isbotlamoq, asossizligini ko'rsatib bermoq.
words.example: The defense lawyer presented solid video evidence to completely refute the false allegations.
words.uzbekExample: Advokat soxta ayblovlarni butunlay rad etish uchun ishonchli video dalillarni taqdim etdi.
words.audioText: Refute. To prove a statement or theory to be false.
words.clozeSentence: New empirical data conclusively ______s the outdated evolutionary theory.

words.definition: Beautiful in a dramatic and eye-catching way; magnificent.
words.uzbekDefinition: Hayratomuz, tomoshabop, ko'zni qamashtiradigan darajada ajoyib.
words.example: The New Year celebration in Sydney concluded with a spectacular fireworks display over the harbor.
words.uzbekExample: Sidneydagi Yangi yil bayrami ko'rfaz uzra ko'zni qamashtiruvchi mushakbozlik tomoshasi bilan yakunlandi.
words.audioText: Spectacular. Beautiful in a dramatic and eye-catching way.
words.clozeSentence: The mountaineers witnessed a ______ sunrise from the summit of the peak.

words.definition: To form fabric or a story by interlacing long threads or intricate plot lines.
words.uzbekDefinition: To'qimoq, iplarni bir-biriga kiritib mato yoki gilam hosil qilmoq; mohirlik bilan asar yaratmoq.
words.example: Traditional Uzbek artisans weave exquisite silk ikat and atlas fabrics using ancient looms.
words.uzbekExample: An'anaviy o'zbek hunarmandlari qadimiy dastgohlar yordamida nafis ipak ikat va atlas matolarini to'qiydilar.
words.audioText: Weave. To form fabric by interlacing threads.
words.clozeSentence: Artisans in Margilan continue to ______ magnificent silk fabrics by hand.

words.definition: A person whose job is to keep or inspect financial accounts and records.
words.uzbekDefinition: Hisobchi, buxgalter, moliyaviy hisobotlarni yurituvchi mutaxassis.
words.example: A certified chartered accountant analyzed the firm's balance sheets before the annual audit.
words.uzbekExample: Sertifikatlangan buxgalter yillik auditdan oldin kompaniyaning balans varaqalarini sinchiklab tahlil qildi.
words.audioText: Accountant. A person whose job is to keep or inspect financial accounts.
words.clozeSentence: The company hired a certified ______ to handle its complex tax deductions.

words.definition: A wealthy person who uses money to invest in trade and industry for profit in accordance with capitalism.
words.uzbekDefinition: Kapitalist, sarmoyador, o'z kapitalini foyda olish uchun biznesga kirituvchi boy shaxs.
words.example: The venture capitalist invested two million dollars into the promising artificial intelligence startup.
words.uzbekExample: Venchur sarmoyadori istiqbolli sun'iy intellekt startapiga ikki million dollar investitsiya qildi.
words.audioText: Capitalist. A person who invests money in business for profit.
words.clozeSentence: A venture ______ provided the initial seed funding for the new mobile app.

words.definition: The feeling that a person or a thing is beneath consideration, worthless, or deserving scorn.
words.uzbekDefinition: Nafrat, mensimaslik, past nazar bilan qarash va tahqirlash hissi.
words.example: The honest judge looked at the remorseless criminal with undisguised contempt.
words.uzbekExample: Halol sudya tavba qilmagan jinoyatchiga yashirilmagan chuqur nafrat bilan qaradi.
words.audioText: Contempt. The feeling that something is worthless or deserving scorn.
words.clozeSentence: The citizens felt nothing but deep ______ for the dishonest politician.

words.definition: To devote time, effort, or oneself to a particular task or purpose.
words.uzbekDefinition: Bag'ishlamoq, butun vaqt va kuchini biror maqsad yo'liga sarflamoq.
words.example: Dr. Alimov decided to dedicate his entire medical career to finding treatments for rare diseases.
words.uzbekExample: Doktor Alimov butun tibbiy faoliyatini kamyob kasalliklarni davolash yo'llarini topishga bag'ishlashga qaror qildi.
words.audioText: Dedicate. To devote time or effort to a particular purpose.
words.clozeSentence: She chose to ______ her life to defending human rights and environmental justice.

words.definition: A narrow channel dug at the side of a road or field, to hold or carry away water.
words.uzbekDefinition: Ariq, xandaq, yo'l yoki dala yoqasidagi chuqur suv oqadigan joy.
words.example: Heavy rain filled the roadside drainage ditch with rushing muddy water.
words.uzbekExample: Kuchli yomg'ir yo'l chetidagi suv oqish arig'ini loyqa suv bilan to'ldirdi.
words.audioText: Ditch. A narrow channel dug to carry away water.
words.clozeSentence: The tractor slipped off the muddy road and landed safely in a shallow ______.

words.definition: A project or undertaking, especially a bold or complex one; a business or company.
words.uzbekDefinition: Korxona, tashabbus, katta va jasoratli ishbilarmonlik loyihasi.
words.example: Launching a clean energy startup is a bold and ambitious commercial enterprise.
words.uzbekExample: Toza energiya startapini ishga tushirish jasoratli va ulkan tijorat korxonasidir.
words.audioText: Enterprise. A bold project or business undertaking.
words.clozeSentence: Launching the tech incubator proved to be a lucrative commercial ______.

words.definition: Extremely beautiful and delicate; crafted with supreme skill.
words.uzbekDefinition: Nafis, ajoyib, beqiyos go'zal va nozik did bilan yaratilgan.
words.example: The bride wore a handmade wedding gown adorned with exquisite lace and pearls.
words.uzbekExample: Kelin nafis to'r va marvaridlar bilan bezatilgan qo'lda tikilgan to'y libosini kiygan edi.
words.audioText: Exquisite. Extremely beautiful and delicate.
words.clozeSentence: The museum displayed an ______ collection of Persian miniature paintings.

words.definition: The management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.
words.uzbekDefinition: Moliya, pul mablag'larini boshqarish va taqsimlash tizimi.

words.definition: To supply water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.definition: Relating to money or currency.

words.definition: A measure taken in advance to prevent something dangerous, unpleasant, or inconvenient from happening.

words.definition: Denoting an action or event preceding or done in preparation for something more full or important.

words.definition: To cause something to become thoroughly soaked with liquid so that no more can be absorbed.

words.definition: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do; freedom from complexity.

words.definition: To plant seeds by scattering them on or in the earth.

words.definition: A protein-rich bean used to make food products, oil, milk, and tofu.

words.definition: Happening or appearing soon; forthcoming.

words.clozeSentence: Candidates are studying diligently for their ______ IELTS examination.

words.definition: Present or experienced to a severe or intense degree; sharp.

words.definition: Hostile or violent behavior or feelings; readiness to attack or confront.

words.definition: To help or encourage something to increase, improve, or become more successful.

words.definition: To strike the palms of one's hands together repeatedly, typically in applause.

words.definition: To force or oblige someone to do something.
words.uzbekDefinition: Majbur qilmoq, majburlamoq, ixtiyorsiz undamoq.

words.definition: Power and influence over others; supreme control or supremacy.

words.definition: Beautiful; very attractive and pleasing to the senses.

words.definition: A work of outstanding artistry, skill, or workmanship.

words.definition: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with men.

words.definition: Having well-developed muscles; strong and brawny.
words.uzbekDefinition: Mushakdor, baquvvat, qomatdor va gavdali.

words.uzbekExample: Og'ir atletikachilar kunlik mashg'ulotlar va oqsil iste'moli orqali nihoyatda baquvvat mushakdor qomatni saqlaydilar.
words.audioText: Muscular. Having well-developed muscles; strong.

words.definition: The position in which someone holds their body when standing or sitting.

words.uzbekExample: Kompyuter stolida ishlaganda qaddini to'g'ri tutish surunkali bel og'rig'ining oldini oladi.
words.audioText: Posture. The position in which someone holds their body.

words.definition: To observe and direct the execution of a task, project, or activity.

words.definition: A university student who has not yet received a first degree.

words.definition: A small natural stream of fresh water.

words.definition: To provide food and drink, typically at social events; to satisfy a specific need.

words.definition: Carefully thinking about and respecting the feelings and needs of others.

words.definition: The using up of a resource or the action of eating or drinking.

words.definition: Standards by which something may be judged or decided.

words.definition: The tough outer part of a loaf of bread, or the outermost solid shell of a rocky planet.

words.definition: To cause someone to lose respect; to break down or deteriorate chemically.
words.uzbekDefinition: Kamsitmoq, obro'sizlantirmoq; moddaning chirishi yoki parchalanishi.

words.definition: To give someone a legal right or a just claim to receive or do something.

words.definition: To accompany someone or something somewhere, especially for protection or guidance.

words.definition: Belonging to or forming the outer surface or structure of something.

words.definition: A place, amenity, or piece of equipment provided for a particular purpose.

words.definition: A department or group of related departments in a university; or the teaching staff.

words.definition: A thing used to make something look more attractive but having no practical purpose, especially a small object such as a figurine.

words.definition: To feel deep respect or admiration for someone or something.

words.audioText: Wax. A substance used for candles and polish.

words.definition: A thing that can be added to something else in order to make it more useful, versatile, or attractive.

words.definition: Satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity; sufficient.

words.uzbekDefinition: Karton, qutilar yasash uchun ishlatiladigan qalin qattiq qog'oz.
words.example: Online purchases are securely packaged in sturdy recycled cardboard boxes.
words.uzbekExample: Onlayn xaridlar mustahkam qayta ishlangan karton qutilarga xavfsiz qadoqlanadi.
words.audioText: Cardboard. Pasteboard or stiff thick paper.
words.clozeSentence: They packed all their antique books into durable ______ boxes for moving.

words.definition: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.
words.uzbekDefinition: Dilemma, boshi berk ko'cha, ikki qiyin tanlov orasidagi og'ir holat.
words.example: She faced a painful moral dilemma: tell the truth and risk friendship, or stay silent.
words.uzbekExample: U og'riqli axloqiy dilemma oldida qoldi: haqiqatni aytib do'stlikni xavf ostiga qo'yish yoki jim turish.
words.audioText: Dilemma. A difficult choice between two alternatives.
words.clozeSentence: The government faces a profound economic ______ between growth and inflation.

words.definition: Involving many carefully arranged parts or details; detailed and complicated in design.
words.uzbekDefinition: Batafsil, mukammal ishlangan, mayda tafsilotlarigacha o'ylangan.
words.example: The architecture featured elaborate geometric mosaics characteristic of Islamic medieval art.
words.uzbekExample: Me'morchilik islomiy o'rta asr san'atiga xos bo'lgan nozik va mukammal geometrik mozaikalarni namoyish etdi.
words.audioText: Elaborate. Involving many carefully arranged parts; detailed.
words.clozeSentence: The detective uncovered an ______ international conspiracy to rig the election.

words.definition: To make an action or process easy or easier.
words.uzbekDefinition: Osonlashtirmoq, yengillashtirmoq, jarayonni tez va qulay qilmoq.
words.example: Modern educational technologies facilitate active collaborative learning between students.
words.uzbekExample: Zamonaviy ta'lim texnologiyalari talabalar o'rtasidagi faol hamkorlikda o'rganishni osonlashtiradi.
words.audioText: Facilitate. To make an action or process easier.
words.clozeSentence: Interactive flashcard algorithms ______ rapid memorization of academic terms.

words.definition: A group of ships sailing together; or a number of vehicles operating under one owner.
words.uzbekDefinition: Flot, kema yoki transport vositalarining birgalikdagi guruhi.
words.example: The logistics delivery company expanded its fleet with hundreds of zero-emission electric vans.
words.uzbekExample: Logistika yetkazib berish kompaniyasi o'z avtoparkini yuzlab chiqindisiz elektr furgonlar bilan kengaytirdi.
words.audioText: Fleet. A group of ships or vehicles operating together.
words.clozeSentence: The delivery service upgraded its commercial vehicle ______ to reduce carbon emissions.

words.definition: A framework of spaced bars that are parallel to or cross each other; a network of electrical power lines.
words.uzbekDefinition: Panjara, katakchalar to'ri; shuningdek, elektr energiya taqsimlash tarmog'i.
words.example: Extreme winter storms damaged transformers and knocked out the regional electrical grid.
words.uzbekExample: Qahraton qish bo'ronlari transformatorlarni shikastlab, mintaqaviy elektr tarmog'ini ishdan chiqardi.
words.audioText: Grid. A framework of parallel or crossing bars; a power network.
words.clozeSentence: Severe lightning strikes knocked out power across the state electrical ______.

words.definition: To bring goods or services into a country from abroad for sale.
words.uzbekDefinition: Import qilmoq, chet eldan tovar yoki xizmatlarni olib kirmoq.
words.example: Uzbekistan continues to import high-tech industrial machinery from Germany and Japan.
words.uzbekExample: O'zbekiston Germaniya va Yaponiyadan yuqori texnologiyali sanoat uskunalarini import qilishda davom etmoqda.
words.audioText: Import. To bring goods into a country from abroad.
words.clozeSentence: Developing economies often ______ specialized technology from industrial nations.

words.definition: To deduce or conclude information from evidence and reasoning rather than explicit statements.
words.uzbekDefinition: Xulosa chiqarmoq, tag ma'nosini anglab yetmoq, dalillardan fahmlamoq.
words.example: In the IELTS Reading test, students must frequently infer the author's implied attitude from the text.
words.uzbekExample: IELTS Reading testida talabalar matndan muallifning yashirin munosabatini tez-tez fahmlab xulosa chiqarishlari kerak.
words.audioText: Infer. To deduce information from evidence and reasoning.
words.clozeSentence: Readers can easily ______ the character's guilt from his nervous behavior.

words.definition: To fill a balloon, tire, or other expandable object with air or gas; to increase prices artificially.
words.uzbekDefinition: Damlamaq, shishirmoq; sun'iy ravishda narxni ko'tarmoq.
words.example: Make sure you inflate your bicycle tires to the recommended pressure before a long journey.
words.uzbekExample: Uzoq safarga chiqishdan oldin velosiped shinalarini tavsiya etilgan bosimda damlaganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.
words.audioText: Inflate. To fill an object with air or gas.
words.clozeSentence: Use the foot pump to ______ the inflatable kayak before heading into the river.

words.definition: Inborn; natural; existing in someone from birth rather than learned.
words.uzbekDefinition: Tug'ma, fitriy, tabiatan mavjud bo'lgan xislat.
words.example: Young children seem to possess an innate curiosity to explore and understand the world.
words.uzbekExample: Kichik bolalar dunyoni tadqiq qilish va tushunish bo'yicha tug'ma qiziquvchanlikka ega bo'ladilar.
words.audioText: Innate. Inborn; natural; existing from birth.
words.clozeSentence: Musicians often exhibit an ______ musical talent from their earliest years.

words.definition: A hard crystalline metamorphic form of limestone, typically white with coloured streaks, used in sculpture and architecture.
words.uzbekDefinition: Marmar, haykaltaroshlik va me'morchilikda ishlatiladigan nafis qattiq tosh.
words.example: The palace ballroom floor was laid with polished white Italian Carrara marble.
words.uzbekExample: Qasrning bal zali poliga silliqlangan oq rangli Italiya Karrara marmari yotqizilgan edi.
words.audioText: Marble. A hard crystalline rock used in sculpture and architecture.
words.clozeSentence: The sculptor chiseled a stunning heroic statue out of solid ______.

words.definition: A tall upright post, spar, or other structure on a ship or boat, in sailing vessels carrying a sail or sails.
words.uzbekDefinition: Machta, yelkanli kema ustuni; yelkan va bayroqlar bog'lanadigan baland tik yog'och.
words.example: The captain ordered the crew to climb the main mast and unfurl the giant canvas sails.
words.uzbekExample: Kapitan jamoaga asosiy machtaga chiqib, bahaybat brezent yelkanlarni yoyishni buyurdi.
words.audioText: Mast. A tall upright structure on a ship carrying sails.
words.clozeSentence: The ferocious sea gale snapped the wooden ______ of the fishing schooner.

words.definition: A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.
words.uzbekDefinition: Ko'ngil aynishi, behalovatlik va qayt qilish istagi.
words.example: Turbulence on the small airplane caused acute motion sickness and nausea among several passengers.
words.uzbekExample: Kichik samolyotdagi turbulentlik bir nechta yo'lovchilarda kuchli chayqalish va ko'ngil aynishiga sabab bo'ldi.
words.audioText: Nausea. A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.
words.clozeSentence: Rough stormy ocean waves induced intense seasickness and ______ in the travelers.

words.definition: Relating to a country's navy, warships, or maritime combat forces.
words.uzbekDefinition: Harbiy dengiz kuchlariga oid, harbiy flotga daxldor.
words.example: The historic naval battle off the coast of Trafalgar cemented British maritime supremacy.
words.uzbekExample: Trafalgar qirg'og'i yaqinidagi tarixiy harbiy dengiz jangi Britaniyaning dengizdagi hukmronligini mustahkamladi.
words.audioText: Naval. Relating to a country's navy or warships.
words.clozeSentence: The destroyer returned safely to the deepwater ______ base after patrol.

words.definition: A small flexible bag, typically carried on a person; or a pocket of skin in which animals carry their young.
words.uzbekDefinition: Xaltacha, hamyoncha; shuningdek, kenguru kabi jonivorlarning bolasini olib yuradigan qorin xaltasi.
words.example: A mother kangaroo protects and nurses her newborn joey inside her warm abdominal pouch.
words.uzbekExample: Ona kenguru o'zining yangi tug'ilgan bolasini iliq qorin xaltachasi ichida himoya qiladi va emizadi.
words.audioText: Pouch. A small flexible bag or skin pocket in animals.
words.clozeSentence: He stored his gold coins securely inside a small drawstring leather ______.

words.definition: Holding as much water or moisture as can be absorbed; thoroughly soaked.
words.uzbekDefinition: Shilta bo'lgan, suvga to'yingan, butunlay ho'l bo'lib ketgan.
words.example: After walking through the heavy storm without an umbrella, his clothes were completely saturated.
words.uzbekExample: Zontiksiz kuchli bo'ron ostida yurgach, uning kiyimlari shilta bo'lib suvga to'yib ketgan edi.
words.audioText: Saturated. Holding as much moisture as can be absorbed.
words.clozeSentence: His wool coat was entirely ______ after standing in the downpour for an hour.

words.definition: Incorporating the most recent facts, changes, and modern features.
words.uzbekDefinition: Yangilangan, zamonaviylashtirilgan, eng so'nggi ma'lumotlar bilan to'ldirilgan.
words.example: The website includes an updated curriculum with full audio phonetics and verified Uzbek explanations.
words.uzbekExample: Veb-sayt to'liq audio talaffuz va tekshirilgan o'zbekcha izohlarga ega yangilangan o'quv dasturini o'z ichiga oladi.
words.audioText: Updated. Incorporating the most recent facts and modern features.
words.clozeSentence: Students downloaded the ______ edition of the digital IELTS handbook.
